Check our calculator to see what payments your family might qualify for. You’ll just need your family details and income information handy.

Whakarewarewa Forest Loop | RotoruaNZ

One of the best things to do in Rotorua is to ride the new Whakarewarewa Forest Loop!

The Loop is a 33km circular mountain biking trail located in Whakarewarewa Forest (aka The Redwoods) just 10 minutes (by car) from the city center of Rotorua, making it super quick and easy to get to and fit around your other sightseeing activities.

Being mostly a Grade 2 track with a couple Grade 3 sections mixed in, the Loop is designed to be accessible for people of almost all ages, abilities and fitness levels. You don’t need to be a professional downhiller; as long as you’re a confident rider, you’ll find the variety of uphill, downhill and flat sections interesting, fun and fairly easy to navigate.

Click here for more information on the Whakarewarewa Forest Loop: https://www.rotoruanz.com/visit/whakarewarewa-forest-loop?gclid=Cj0KCQjwyMiTBhDKARIsAAJ-9VvOub5saUfKgwwgKdHwIQS3s7ai7WB2eOWUlsRYaz9hiy2z3YVZlyQaAmeJEALw_wcB
